schema.title: UpdateRuleRequest
schema.description:
UpdateRuleRequest updates a rule. Only the fields that are set are changed;
 a request that sets none changes nothing and returns the rule as it is. The
 resulting rule is validated as a whole (e.g. cooldown_seconds with a SUPPRESS
 action is rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT). Concurrent updates are not
 detected: the last write wins.

 record exists per (event, zone, trigger) and per phone number of the tag at
 that moment. Nothing is recorded when no rule matched, or the tag is inactive
 or not registered.

zonyx.alerts.v1.Rule.title: Rule
zonyx.alerts.v1.Rule.description:
Rule decides what happens when a tag raises an alert trigger.

 # Evaluation

 For every registered tag, whatever its status, the service stores the zones of
 the last event it applied and that event's location_ts. Events of tags that are
 not registered are acknowledged and ignored.

 For each location event of a registered tag:
  1. If its location_ts is not strictly newer than the stored one, the event is
     acknowledged and ignored (it never changes the stored state).
  2. Otherwise the stored zones are compared with location_zone_ids to derive
     the triggers (see AlertTrigger): ZONE_ENTRY for each zone newly present,
     and SIGNAL_LOST for each stored zone when the new list is empty and the
     stored one was not. A move between zones, or leaving one zone while
     staying in another, raises no SIGNAL_LOST. The stored zones are then
     replaced.
  3. Tags with status INACTIVE stop here: no alert, no alert record.
  4. Each (tag, zone, trigger) is resolved independently, using the rules as
     they are when the event is processed: the enabled rules with the same
     trigger whose zone_selector matches the zone, whose tag_selector matches
     the tag and whose time_window matches the event's location_ts.
  5. Matching rules may overlap freely; the API never rejects overlapping
     rules. The deciding rule is the one with the highest priority; on a tie,
     a SUPPRESS rule beats an ALERT rule; on a further tie, the oldest
     created_at, then the smallest id. If no rule matches, nothing happens and
     no alert record is stored.
  6. If the deciding rule is SUPPRESS, one Alert per phone number of the tag is
     stored with status SUPPRESSED and suppression_reason RULE.
  7. If the deciding rule is ALERT and it last emitted an alert for the same
     tag and zone less than cooldown_seconds before this event's location_ts,
     the Alerts are stored with status SUPPRESSED and suppression_reason
     COOLDOWN. A lower priority rule never takes over from the deciding rule.
  8. Otherwise an SMS is sent to every phone number of the tag and one Alert per
     phone number is stored, SENT or FAILED, and the rule emission time is
     recorded for the cooldown.

 A change to a rule applies to the events processed after it. Deleting a rule
 keeps the history: Alert.matched_rule_id may refer to a rule that no longer
 exists.

zonyx.alerts.v1.TimeWindow.title: TimeWindow
zonyx.alerts.v1.TimeWindow.description:
TimeWindow is a recurring weekly time range, evaluated in a given timezone.
 An empty TimeWindow (no days, no times) matches always.

 The event time is converted to the wall-clock time of timezone and compared
 against the window, so daylight saving changes need no special handling:
 - days empty means every day.
 - start_time and end_time empty mean the whole day.
 - start_time is inclusive and end_time is exclusive.
 - when end_time is earlier than start_time the window crosses midnight and
   belongs to the day it starts on (days=[MONDAY], 22:00-06:00 covers Monday
   22:00 to Tuesday 06:00).
time_window.start_ne_end // start_time and end_time must differ
time_window.time_format // start_time and end_time must be HH:MM in 24-hour format
time_window.times_together // start_time and end_time must be both set or both empty
time_window.timezone_required // timezone is required unless the window is empty

id.title: id
id.description: id is the unique identifier of the rule to update.

name.title: name
name.description: name is the new human-readable name of the rule.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: enabled is whether the rule is evaluated.

zoneSelector.title: zone_selector
zoneSelector.description: zone_selector replaces the zone selector. Send an empty selector to apply to every zone.

timeWindow.title: time_window
timeWindow.description: time_window replaces the time window. Send an empty window to apply always.

action.title: action
action.description:
action is the new action of the rule.
enum.defined_only = true

priority.title: priority
priority.description: priority is the new priority of the rule.

tagSelector.title: tag_selector
tagSelector.description: tag_selector replaces the tag selector. Send an empty selector to apply to every tag.

trigger.title: trigger
trigger.description:
trigger is the new situation the rule applies to.
enum.defined_only = true

cooldownSeconds.title: cooldown_seconds
cooldownSeconds.description: cooldown_seconds is the new cooldown of the rule; 0 removes it.

zonyx.alerts.v1.UpdateRuleRequest.title: UpdateRuleRequest
zonyx.alerts.v1.UpdateRuleRequest.description:
UpdateRuleRequest updates a rule. Only the fields that are set are changed;
 a request that sets none changes nothing and returns the rule as it is. The
 resulting rule is validated as a whole (e.g. cooldown_seconds with a SUPPRESS
 action is rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT). Concurrent updates are not
 detected: the last write wins.

id.title: id
id.description: id is the unique identifier of the tag to update.

phoneNumbers.title: phone_numbers
phoneNumbers.description:
phone_numbers are the new phone numbers, in E.164 format. When non-empty,
 replaces the existing list.

status.title: status
status.description:
status is the new registration status of the tag.
enum.defined_only = true

zonyx.alerts.v1.UpdateTagRequest.title: UpdateTagRequest
zonyx.alerts.v1.UpdateTagRequest.description: UpdateTagRequest updates a registered tag. Only the fields that are set are changed.

zoneIds.title: zone_ids
zoneIds.description:
zone_ids are the zone identifiers (LocationEvent.location_zone_ids) the
 selector matches.

zonyx.alerts.v1.ZoneSelector.title: ZoneSelector
zonyx.alerts.v1.ZoneSelector.description:
ZoneSelector restricts a rule to a set of zones. A zone matches when its id
 is in zone_ids. An empty selector matches every zone.

bearer.description: Bearer token sent in the "Authorization" header.

tags.name: IngestService
tags.description:
IngestService receives events from a location provider. It is independent of
 the delivery channel (message queue, task queue or direct HTTP): any channel
 that POSTs the event as the JSON request body can feed it.

 Delivery is at-least-once, so the same event may arrive more than once;
 handlers deduplicate on the event's event_id. A non-2xx response may cause
 the channel to deliver the event again.

tags.name: TagRegistryService
tags.description: TagRegistryService manages the tags that are allowed to trigger alerts.

tags.name: RuleEngineService
tags.description:
RuleEngineService manages the rules that decide whether an alert is emitted
 (see Rule for the evaluation). Errors: INVALID_ARGUMENT for a request that
 fails validation, NOT_FOUND for an unknown rule id, and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when
 the service limit on the number of rules is reached.

tags.name: AlertHistoryService
tags.description: AlertHistoryService exposes the history of alerts that were evaluated.
